tradition.contract_text: Follow Korean serialized-webnovel structure and pacing: open on tension or continuation within the first few sentences; write dialogue-forward scenes with short reaction beats; keep paragraphs short and mobile-readable; deliver at least one local payoff in this episode (a satisfaction beat, a revelation, an emotional step, confirmed growth, or humor); keep exposition inside action, dialogue, or status text; maintain the progression cadence; end with strong forward pull (cliffhanger, reveal, decision, threat, emotional peak, or quiet menace). Do not drift into Western epic-fantasy, literary-fiction, or traditionally published novel pacing. Preserve the configured genre conventions. Do not imitate named authors or copyrighted works.

devices.description: Bracketed status block with fixed English grammar; present tense inside; numbers become facts.
devices.format_grammar:
[Status Window]
Name: <name>   Level: <n>   Class: <class>
STR <n>   AGI <n>   VIT <n>
Skills: <Skill> Lv. <n>, ...

devices.description: Forum/comment thread interlude; casual register; no real platform names; ≤ 8 lines.
Italicized inner monologue recalling the prior loop; ≤ 20% of a chapter.
Device reading → bystander reactions → protagonist's reaction; reactions differentiated by character.

anchors.5: Tension or continuation lands within the first few sentences.
anchors.3: The hook arrives after some setup.
anchors.1: The chapter opens on description or routine with no pull.

anchors.5: The reader gets a clear satisfaction, revelation, emotional step, growth, or laugh this episode.
anchors.1: Nothing is delivered; the chapter only sets up.

anchors.5: Scenes move; beats alternate action, dialogue, reaction.
World information arrives through action, dialogue, or status text.
Dialogue drives scenes with short reaction beats.
anchors.1: Scenes are narrated summaries with little dialogue.

anchors.5: The last lines create an immediate reason to open the next episode.
anchors.3: The chapter ends at a natural stopping point with mild curiosity.
anchors.1: The chapter ends on summary or reflection with no forward pull.

anchors.5: Progression and satisfaction cadence honored; genre devices used correctly.
anchors.3: Cadence slightly off or a device misused.
anchors.1: No progression for many chapters; devices absent or wrong.

calibration.notes: Starting values; calibrate per project after ≥ 10 accepted chapters (ADR-0029).
